messages:
jia: quick heads-up — ran a 12h tool-loop on canary and saw steady mem growth tied to kv pager. not classic leak (no increasing alloc_count) but "pagefold shadowing" looks plausible. attaching quick traces below. 

mike: can you paste the repro steps and the minimal trace?

jia: repro: ./bin/runtime --mode=toolloop --threads=8 --work=longchat --kv-trace=pagefold > /tmp/pf.log 2>&1  &
logs excerpt:
```
KVPager: evict_scan_count=487263
KVPager: page_fold_shadowed=1248
KVPager: frag_ratio=1.18
heap_resident_mb=3240 -> 4120 over 12h
pprof: heap_objects_live=+18k (mostly PageRef structs)
```

sara: hmm we did change kernel-selection heuristics last week to prefer small-kernel tiled kernels for 2048 seq. could that affect page residency patterns?

kevin: @sara good catch. commit 5d2e9b changed tiled-kernel batching and also bumped prefetch window for kv loads. that prefetch could increase simultaneous page refs. not necessarily leaking but increases residency when prefix reuse is high.

mike: ok, so hypothesis: prefetch + long context toolloops => many pages shadowed in pagefold (page referenced by prefetch but not used), preventing eviction. do we have pager counters to prove shadowing?

jia: yes, pager exposes: scan_attempts, fold_hits, fold_shadowed, live_refs_by_epoch. fold_shadowed spikes when we see the growth. sample metrics for the run: scan_attempts=2.1M, fold_hits=9k, fold_shadowed=1248, evict_attempts=1.9M, evict_success=1.88M. so many attempts but a small set of pages repeatedly pinned.

alyssa: can we reproduce in a shorter run? maybe lower prefetch or disable tiled-kernel to see impact. also try forcing a more aggressive eviction policy: 
`KV_PAGER_EVICT_SCAN_LIMIT=20000 KV_PREFETCH_WINDOW=0 ./bin/runtime ...`

kevin: i spun a 2h run with KV_PREFETCH_WINDOW=0 and saw resident drop ~15% vs baseline. not a fix but confirms prefetch influence.

mike: good. next steps: 1) add a one-off diagnostic that emits top 50 pages by refcount and last-used epoch 2) add temporary metric fold_shadowed_rate 3) run canary with prefetch disabled for 24h.

sara: sounds good. i'll open a tiny PR that makes prefetch window configurable via env and adds the diagnostic endpoint `/debug/kv/top-pages?limit=50`.

infra-bot: deploy queued: canary -> runtime/canary v2026.03.12-5d2e9b (add config flag) by sara — ETA 4m

jia: thanks everyone. leaving the long run ingest in progress. will paste the top-pages output when done. :pray:
note: thread contains root message and replies in chronological order; messages are Slack-style short updates and commands
